note: D4 the upgrade slot deepens a build, so it will not spend itself on an ability that is no part of one: the kit is seed_bomb plus the mobility slot, so its + forms are [seed_bomb+, mycelium_dash+] but mycelium_dash+ is pure mobility (Content.AFFINITY_IGNORED_TAGS, read through _build_defining, the same list the affinity set drops) and the slot's candidate list is [seed_bomb+] alone. This board pins both halves of that rule on one roll: slot 1 deals seed_bomb+ and slot 2, the wild slot, deals mycelium_dash+ - the filter narrows the LIST of one slot and never the universe, so the mobility + form is still reachable (and the shrine forge, which reads the kit and not this list, still upcycles it). Drop the filter and the same seed deals mycelium_dash+ from the UPGRADE slot with seed_bomb+ pushed out to wild: the three ids are the same, the roles are swapped, so this record fails in plain mode on its slots without needing the state hash. d4_starved_slot.json is the same board on seed 3, where the filter leaves the offers alone
